product_total.sql: select count(*)::int as n from product where deleted_at is null

product_by_status.sql: select status, count(*)::int as n from product where deleted_at is null group by status order by status

product_deleted.sql: select count(*)::int as n from product where deleted_at is not null

product_variant_total.sql: select count(*)::int as n from product_variant where deleted_at is null

variants_per_product.sql: select cnt as variants, count(*)::int as products from (select product_id, count(*) cnt from product_variant where deleted_at is null group by product_id) x group by cnt order by cnt

variant_manage_inventory.sql: select manage_inventory, count(*)::int as n from product_variant where deleted_at is null group by manage_inventory

product_option_total.sql: select count(*)::int as n from product_option where deleted_at is null

product_tag_total.sql: select count(*)::int as n from product_tag where deleted_at is null

product_type_total.sql: select count(*)::int as n from product_type where deleted_at is null

product_category_total.sql: select count(*)::int as n from product_category where deleted_at is null

product_category_with_parent.sql: select count(*)::int as n from product_category where deleted_at is null and parent_category_id is not null

product_category_product_links.sql: select count(*)::int as n from product_category_product

products_without_category.sql: select count(*)::int as n from product p where p.deleted_at is null and not exists (select 1 from product_category_product c where c.product_id = p.id)

product_collection_total.sql: select count(*)::int as n from product_collection where deleted_at is null

products_in_collection.sql: select count(*)::int as n from product where deleted_at is null and collection_id is not null

image_total.sql: select count(*)::int as n from image where deleted_at is null

image_relative_products_path.sql: select count(*)::int as n from image where deleted_at is null and url like '/products/%'

image_absolute_http.sql: select count(*)::int as n from image where deleted_at is null and url like 'http%'

image_rank_distribution.sql: select rank, count(*)::int as n from image where deleted_at is null group by rank order by rank

products_with_gallery.sql: select count(distinct product_id)::int as n from image where deleted_at is null

products_without_gallery.sql: select p.handle, p.thumbnail from product p where p.deleted_at is null and not exists (select 1 from image i where i.product_id = p.id and i.deleted_at is null) order by p.handle

products_with_thumbnail.sql: select count(*)::int as n from product where deleted_at is null and thumbnail is not null and thumbnail <> ''

thumbnail_equals_gallery_rank0.sql: select count(*)::int as n from product p join image i on i.product_id = p.id and i.rank = 0 and i.deleted_at is null where p.deleted_at is null and p.thumbnail = i.url

thumbnail_not_in_gallery.sql: select count(*)::int as n from product p where p.deleted_at is null and p.thumbnail is not null and not exists (select 1 from image i where i.product_id = p.id and i.url = p.thumbnail and i.deleted_at is null)

region_rows.sql: select id, name, currency_code from region where deleted_at is null order by name

store_currency.sql: select currency_code, is_default from store_currency order by currency_code

price_by_currency.sql: select currency_code, count(*)::int as n from price where deleted_at is null group by currency_code order by currency_code

price_list_total.sql: select count(*)::int as n from price_list where deleted_at is null

prices_with_rules.sql: select count(distinct p.id)::int as n from price p join price_rule r on r.price_id = p.id where p.deleted_at is null

rub_prices_per_variant.sql: select n as rub_prices, count(*)::int as variants from (select v.id, count(p.id) n from product_variant v left join product_variant_price_set vps on vps.variant_id = v.id left join price p on p.price_set_id = vps.price_set_id and p.currency_code = 'rub' and p.deleted_at is null where v.deleted_at is null group by v.id) x group by n order by n

site_locale_rows.sql: select code, enabled, is_default from site_locale order by code

product_translation_total.sql: select count(*)::int as n from product_translation

product_translation_by_locale.sql: select locale, count(*)::int as n from product_translation group by locale order by locale

product_translation_for_live_products.sql: select count(*)::int as n from product_translation t where exists (select 1 from product p where p.handle = t.product_handle and p.deleted_at is null)

product_translation_for_deleted_products.sql: select count(*)::int as n from product_translation t where exists (select 1 from product p where p.handle = t.product_handle and p.deleted_at is not null)

product_metadata_i18n.sql: select count(*)::int as n from product where deleted_at is null and metadata ? 'i18n'

translation_by_resource_locale.sql: select resource, locale, count(*)::int as n from translation group by resource, locale order by resource, locale

translation_ui_ru_by_prefix.sql: select p as prefix, count(*)::int as n from (select split_part(resource_key, '.', 1) p from translation where resource = 'ui' and locale = 'ru') x group by p order by n desc, p

home_banner_total.sql: select count(*)::int as n from home_banner

home_banner_active.sql: select count(*)::int as n from home_banner where active and deleted_at is null

shipping_option_rows.sql: select id, name, provider_id, price_type from shipping_option where deleted_at is null order by name

customer_total.sql: select count(*)::int as n from customer where deleted_at is null

order_total.sql: select count(*)::int as n from "order" where deleted_at is null

article_total.sql: select count(*)::int as n from article

article_by_locale_status.sql: select locale, status, count(*)::int as n from article group by locale, status order by locale, status

course_total.sql: select count(*)::int as n from course

course_entitlement_total.sql: select count(*)::int as n from course_entitlement

course_progress_total.sql: select count(*)::int as n from course_progress

pickup_point_record_total.sql: select count(*)::int as n from pickup_point_record

order_tracking_total.sql: select count(*)::int as n from order_tracking

loyalty_gift_card_total.sql: select count(*)::int as n from loyalty_gift_card

agent_conversation_total.sql: select count(*)::int as n from agent_conversation

ai_image_generation_total.sql: select count(*)::int as n from ai_image_generation

provider_identity_by_provider.sql: select provider, count(*)::int as n from provider_identity group by provider order by provider

layout_configuration_total.sql: select count(*)::int as n from layout_configuration
